title: vtc-00: captions and DRM in hosted streams
description: Captions in hosted streams as an advertised, protocol-neutral track list (kind, language, format), alongside today's chat-message captions. DRM: optional and only signalled (e.g. encrypted flag plus key-system identifiers); the reference path stays unencrypted so free tools work. Key-provider protocols and packaging formats appear only as non-normative examples.
